_comment: Two QuestionnaireResponse variants for demo. Upload only ONE at a time depending on which disposition you want to demo. The Triage Agent reads these as the patient's answers to its targeted follow-up questions.

item.text: How would you describe the chest pain? (sharp/stabbing vs pressure/tight)

answer.valueString: Sharp and stabbing, especially when I take a deep breath

item.text: Does the pain change with breathing or position?

answer.valueString: Yes — it gets noticeably worse when I take a deep breath in

item.text: Have you noticed any swelling, pain, redness, or tenderness in either calf?

answer.valueString: Now that you mention it, my right calf has been a bit sore for the past 3-4 days. I thought it was from the flight.

item.text: Have you coughed up any blood or blood-tinged sputum?
Confirm: any recent long flights, car rides, surgery, or extended bed rest in the last 4 weeks?

answer.valueString: Yes — 15-hour direct flight 10 days ago, and I had a tooth extraction surgery 3 weeks before that with 2 days of bed rest

item.text: Any personal or family history of blood clots, DVT, or pulmonary embolism?

answer.valueString: My aunt had a clot in her leg after surgery years ago. I haven't had any.

item.text: Has your heart been racing or pounding when you are not exerting yourself?

answer.valueString: Yes, even sitting down it feels like it is going faster than usual

item.text: How would you describe the chest pain? (sharp/stabbing vs pressure/tight)

answer.valueString: It is more of a tight band feeling, and it gets worse when I have been stressed at work

item.text: Does the pain change with breathing or position?

answer.valueString: No — it feels the same whether I breathe deep or not

item.text: Have you noticed any swelling, pain, redness, or tenderness in either calf?

answer.valueString: No, my legs feel completely normal

item.text: Have you coughed up any blood or blood-tinged sputum?
Confirm: any recent long flights, car rides, surgery, or extended bed rest in the last 4 weeks?

answer.valueString: The flight 10 days ago was the only thing. I walked around every couple hours during it.

item.text: Any personal or family history of blood clots, DVT, or pulmonary embolism?

answer.valueString: No, nothing on either side of my family

item.text: Has your heart been racing or pounding when you are not exerting yourself?

answer.valueString: Not really — only when I am walking or going up stairs

item.text: Are there any recent stressors, sleep changes, or anxiety symptoms?

answer.valueString: Honestly yes. Hot flashes have been waking me up at night for months, my mother passed away 6 weeks ago, and work has been intense. I have been feeling more anxious than usual.

item.text: Does anything make the chest pain better?

answer.valueString: When I sit down quietly and breathe slowly, it eases off in 10-15 minutes
